title: Andrea First meeting

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: Haven't I seen you before? You used to come to the club?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haven't I seen you before? You used to come to the club?

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: Glitch Swings. The old hole in Nagata. Before it got shut down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Glitch Swings. The old hole in Nagata. Before it got shut down.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: Same thing that happened to all the old spots. Corp-Sec. The anti-Jazz laws were a joke at first, until they weren't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Same thing that happened to all the old spots. Corp-Sec. The anti-Jazz laws were a joke at first, until they weren't.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: Never a place like it. Started by Rollin' Ruby Duplass, back when she could still play the holo-drums.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Never a place like it. Started by Rollin' Ruby Duplass, back when she could still play the holo-drums.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: She used the holo-tech from her bass drum to create a force field. Took them that entire time to get to her. Never saw her again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She used the holo-tech from her bass drum to create a force field. Took them that entire time to get to her. Never saw her again.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: Pffff jazz license. What a joke. Hiding art behind law. We live in a weak world.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Pffff jazz license. What a joke. Hiding art behind law. We live in a weak world.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: You should have seen Caravan back in its day. We would have melted you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should have seen Caravan back in its day. We would have melted you.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: Corp-Sec don't care what you got. They just want Jazz off the streets. They don't like anything they can't monetize. We played it by the book.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Corp-Sec don't care what you got. They just want Jazz off the streets. They don't like anything they can't monetize. We played it by the book.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: Singer mostly, wrote all my own stuff too. Now I just write about survivors guilt. I should be in there with them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Singer mostly, wrote all my own stuff too. Now I just write about survivors guilt. I should be in there with them.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: A band should be together. Especially a Jazz band.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A band should be together. Especially a Jazz band.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Which club?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Which club?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've never heard of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've never heard of it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure. It sounds familiar.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure. It sounds familiar.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure. It sounds familiar.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure. It sounds familiar.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: Coolest damn place this city ever had. Everything is worse now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Coolest damn place this city ever had. Everything is worse now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened to her?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened to her?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like it didn't have a jazz license.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like it didn't have a jazz license.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like it didn't have a jazz license.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like it didn't have a jazz license.

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: The first time they tried to shut down the club, Ruby took her Holo-Drums down to Corp-Sec HQ and played a fourteen hour solo in the waiting area.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The first time they tried to shut down the club, Ruby took her Holo-Drums down to Corp-Sec HQ and played a fourteen hour solo in the waiting area.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fourteen hours?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fourteen hours?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like Corp-sec did the right thing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like Corp-sec did the right thing.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like Corp-sec did the right thing.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like Corp-sec did the right thing.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Poor woman.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Poor woman.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll be honest, I never really understood Jazz.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll be honest, I never really understood Jazz.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll be honest, I never really understood Jazz.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll be honest, I never really understood Jazz.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're right. I miss Jazz.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're right. I miss Jazz.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Was that your band?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Was that your band?

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: More of a collective, a family. Torn apart by the bureaucracy. I'm the only one not on the inside now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: More of a collective, a family. Torn apart by the bureaucracy. I'm the only one not on the inside now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They should have had a license.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They should have had a license.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: They should have had a license.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: They should have had a license.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Awful! Were you not granted a license?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Awful! Were you not granted a license?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Awful! Were you not granted a license?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Awful! Were you not granted a license?

nodes.speaker: Andrea Cellini
nodes.text: We had licenses coming out our chrome AI-enhanced trumpets. Literally in Slippery Lou's case.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We had licenses coming out our chrome AI-enhanced trumpets. Literally in Slippery Lou's case.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And you still got shut down?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And you still got shut down?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And you still got shut down?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And you still got shut down?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What did you play?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What did you play?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like an unpleasant place to be.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like an unpleasant place to be.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like an unpleasant place to be.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like an unpleasant place to be.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So the licenses were just a facade?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So the licenses were just a facade?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So the licenses were just a facade?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So the licenses were just a facade?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Glitch Swings was a Jazz club?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Glitch Swings was a Jazz club?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Glitch Swings was a Jazz club?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Glitch Swings was a Jazz club?
